title: Kasugayama Castle
scope: Central surviving Kasugayama mountain castle earthworks, including the summit, southwest keep and well terraces, second enclosure and eastern spur approach.
limitations: This central ridge model ends above the wider eastern castle grounds and excludes the modern shrine, outer defensive perimeter and reconstructed gate features.

The terrain is survey-derived. The featured summit marker and signs match the exterior photograph in form. Individual plants, trail surfaces, furnishings and stone inscriptions are represented approximately.
